products.description: Foundation: Liquid or cream skin-tone base. Provides buildable medium-to-full coverage with a seamless skin-like luminous finish that never cakes.

products.description: Concealer: Thick cream to hide spots or dark circles. High-coverage creamy formula enriched with caffeine and peptides to instantly erase blemishes.

products.name: Hydra-Dew Tinted Moisturizer / BB Cream

products.name: All-Day Lock Setting Powder & Mist Duo

products.name: Petal Silk Soft Powder & Cream Blush
products.description: Blush: Adds pink or peach color to cheeks. Silky micronized formula that melts seamlessly into the skin for a healthy, youthful flush of color.
benefits: Adds pink or peach color to cheeks

products.name: Sun-Drenched Warm Glow Bronzer
products.description: Bronzer: Adds a warm, sun-tanned look. Infused with golden undertones and cocoa butter to create radiant warmth without orange cast or muddy streaks.

products.description: Highlighter: Adds a bright, shiny glow to high points of the face. Ultra-refined light-refracting pearls give a glass-skin luminous sheen without chunky glitter.

products.name: Sculpt & Define Precision Cream Contour
products.description: Contour: Darker shade used to shape and slim features. Cool-toned matte formula mimics natural facial shadows to carve out cheekbones and define the jaw.

products.name: Glass-Shine Hydrating Plumping Lip Gloss

products.name: Stay-All-Day Precision Velvet Lip Liner
products.description: Lip Liner: Pencil to outline the lips. Creamy water-resistant pencil that defines, reshapes, and prevents lipstick from feathering or bleeding.
products.howToUse: Trace the outer perimeter of your lip line, slightly contouring the cupid’s bow. Fill in entire lips as a base if desired.
